031/**
032 * Default {@link RestDebugFormatter} implementation &mdash; secure by default.
033 *
034 * <p>
035 * Renders, cumulatively by tier:
036 * <ul>
037 *    <li><b>Basic ({@code INFO})</b> &mdash; a single status line ({@code [status] HTTP method uri}), with the method and
038 *       URI sanitized and the URI length-capped.
039 *    <li><b>Headers ({@code FINE})</b> &mdash; request/response header blocks (<b>every</b> value of every header,
040 *       credential-bearing values masked, all names/values sanitized and bounded), plus request/response lengths and the
041 *       request execution time.
042 *    <li><b>Body ({@code FINEST})</b> &mdash; request/response bodies, but <b>only if the operator has opted in</b> (see
043 *       below); otherwise a suppression placeholder + byte count.
044 * </ul>
045 *
046 * <h5 class='section'>Secure-by-default body handling</h5>
047 * <p>
048 * Bodies are <b>never dumped by default</b>. Dumping is a deliberate operator opt-in behind a single environment-variable
049 * master gate, {@code JUNEAU_REST_DEBUG_ALLOW_DUMP_BODIES}:
050 * <ul>
051 *    <li><b>Env-only.</b> It is an environment variable, never a system property, and has no system-property fallback
052 *       &mdash; application code cannot flip it at runtime.
053 *    <li><b>Truthy semantics.</b> The raw value is trimmed, then a non-empty value enables dumping except case-insensitive
054 *       {@code false}/{@code 0}; unset/empty/all-whitespace disables. It is resolved once and cached, making it an
055 *       emergency kill switch.
056 *    <li><b>Gate subordinate.</b> With the gate unset, {@link #formatBody(RestRequest,RestResponse) formatBody} emits only
057 *       the suppression placeholder + byte count &mdash; always, even if a {@link RestDebugBodyScrubber} is configured
058 *       (the scrubber is never invoked).
059 *    <li><b>Renderable content only.</b> Even when opted in, only renderable content (see
060 *       {@link #isBodyRenderable(String)}, plus an identity {@code Content-Encoding}) is dumped; binary/unknown/compressed
061 *       content yields a distinct non-renderable placeholder.
062 *    <li><b>Fail-closed scrubber.</b> When the gate is set and a {@link RestDebugBodyScrubber} is configured, its output is
063 *       dumped (then sanitized and capped); if it throws or returns <jk>null</jk>, the body fails closed to a placeholder
064 *       &mdash; never the raw body.
065 * </ul>
066 * No bytes appear in any placeholder in any representation.
067 *
068 * <h5 class='section'>Header redaction and sanitization</h5>
069 * <p>
070 * Values for a widened, formatter-local credential-bearing header set are masked with {@link RedactedHeaders#REDACTED}.
071 * The set starts from {@link RedactedHeaders#DEFAULT} plus {@code X-Auth-Token}, {@code X-Authorization},
072 * {@code WWW-Authenticate}, {@code Referer}, and {@code Location}; the shared {@link RedactedHeaders#DEFAULT} is left
073 * unchanged. Matching is case-insensitive with separator folding ({@code -}/{@code _} stripped), so {@code X-Auth-Token},
074 * {@code X_Auth_Token}, and {@code XAuthToken} all match. Replace the set with {@link #redactedHeaders(Collection)} or
075 * extend it with {@link #addRedactedHeaders(Collection)}. Every emitted string (URI/method, header names/values, body
076 * text, placeholders) is sanitized against CR/LF/control-char log forging via {@link DebugTextSanitizer}, in
077 * <b>mask &rarr; escape &rarr; cap</b> order.
078 *
079 * <h5 class='section'>Bounds</h5>
080 * <p>
081 * Bodies are bounded by {@link #bodyCap()} bytes (default <b>8&nbsp;KB</b>) at capture time; headers by
082 * {@link #maxHeaders(int)}/{@link #maxHeaderScan(int)}/{@link #maxFieldLength(int)}; the URI by {@link #maxUriLength(int)}.
083 * The 8&nbsp;KB body cap is deliberately smaller than {@code EchoMixin}'s 1&nbsp;MB body cap &mdash; debug logging is
084 * intended for low-volume operator diagnostics; the two caps are independent by design.
085 *
086 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
087 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/RestServerLoggingAndDebugging">Logging / Debugging</a>
088 * </ul>
089 *
090 * @since 10.0.0
091 */
092public class BasicRestDebugFormatter implements RestDebugFormatter {
093
094   /** Default body capture cap, in bytes (8&nbsp;KB). */
095   public static final int DEFAULT_BODY_CAP = 8 * 1024;
096
097   /** The environment variable that gates body dumping. */
098   static final String ENV_ALLOW_DUMP_BODIES = "JUNEAU_REST_DEBUG_ALLOW_DUMP_BODIES";
099
100   /**
101    * The widened, formatter-local default set of header names whose values are masked. Starts from a copy of
102    * {@link RedactedHeaders#DEFAULT} and adds the credential-bearing headers the shared default omits.
103    */
104   static final Set<String> DEFAULT_REDACTED_HEADERS;
105   static {
106      var s = new LinkedHashSet<>(RedactedHeaders.DEFAULT);
107      s.add("X-Auth-Token");
108      s.add("X-Authorization");
109      s.add("WWW-Authenticate");
110      s.add("Referer");
111      s.add("Location");
112      DEFAULT_REDACTED_HEADERS = Collections.unmodifiableSet(s);
113   }
114
115   /**
116    * Cached resolution of the body-dump master gate. {@code null} means "not yet resolved"; resolution reads the
117    * environment exactly once. Not a system property, and there is no system-property fallback.
118    */
119   private static volatile Boolean allowDumpBodiesCache;
120
121   /** The set of header names whose values are masked. Overridable via {@link #redactedHeaders(Collection)}. */
122   protected Set<String> redactedHeaders = DEFAULT_REDACTED_HEADERS;
123
124   /** Optional body scrubber applied to body text when the master gate is set. */
125   protected RestDebugBodyScrubber bodyScrubber;
126
127   /** The body capture cap in bytes. Overridable via {@link #bodyCap(int)}. */
128   protected int bodyCap = DEFAULT_BODY_CAP;
129
130   /** Cap on emitted header values per block. Overridable via {@link #maxHeaders(int)}. */
131   protected int maxHeaders = 100;
132
133   /** Cap on values scanned while computing omitted counts. Overridable via {@link #maxHeaderScan(int)}. */
134   protected int maxHeaderScan = 1000;
135
136   /** Per header name/value length cap after masking/escaping. Overridable via {@link #maxFieldLength(int)}. */
137   protected int maxFieldLength = 1024;
138
139   /** Rendered URI length cap. Overridable via {@link #maxUriLength(int)}. */
140   protected int maxUriLength = DEFAULT_MAX_URI_LENGTH;
141
142   /**
143    * Constructor.
144    */
145   public BasicRestDebugFormatter() {
146      // No state to initialize; all fields have field-level defaults.
147   }
148
149   /**
150    * Constructor.
151    *
152    * <p>
153    * Provided so subclasses can be instantiated through the {@link BeanInstantiator} chain (constructor injection).
154    *
155    * @param beanStore The bean store. Ignored by the default implementation.
156    */
157   public BasicRestDebugFormatter(BeanStore beanStore) {
158      // beanStore is intentionally unused; this overload only exists to satisfy constructor-injection.
159   }
160
161   /**
162    * Overrides the redacted-header set (replaces the built-in widened set).
163    *
164    * @param value The new set of header names to mask (case-insensitive, separator-folded). Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
165    * @return This object.
166    */
167   public BasicRestDebugFormatter redactedHeaders(Collection<String> value) {
168      redactedHeaders = new LinkedHashSet<>(value);
169      return this;
170   }
171
172   /**
173    * Extends the redacted-header set additively (keeps the built-in widened protections).
174    *
175    * @param value The header names to add to the masked set (case-insensitive, separator-folded). Must not be
176    *    <jk>null</jk>.
177    * @return This object.
178    */
179   public BasicRestDebugFormatter addRedactedHeaders(Collection<String> value) {
180      var s = new LinkedHashSet<>(redactedHeaders);
181      s.addAll(value);
182      redactedHeaders = s;
183      return this;
184   }
185
186   /**
187    * Sets the body scrubber applied to body text when the {@code JUNEAU_REST_DEBUG_ALLOW_DUMP_BODIES} gate is set.
188    *
189    * <p>
190    * The scrubber only ever runs when the gate is set; it chooses scrubbed-vs-raw once dumping is already permitted. It
191    * is fail-closed: a throw or a <jk>null</jk> return yields a placeholder, never the raw body.
192    *
193    * @param value The scrubber, or <jk>null</jk> for none (the default, which dumps raw when gated).
194    * @return This object.
195    */
196   public BasicRestDebugFormatter bodyScrubber(RestDebugBodyScrubber value) {
197      bodyScrubber = value;
198      return this;
199   }
200
201   /**
202    * Overrides the body capture cap.
203    *
204    * @param value The new cap in bytes.
205    * @return This object.
206    */
207   public BasicRestDebugFormatter bodyCap(int value) {
208      bodyCap = value;
209      return this;
210   }
211
212   /**
213    * Overrides the cap on emitted header values per block.
214    *
215    * @param value The new cap. Must be &ge; 0.
216    * @return This object.
217    */
218   public BasicRestDebugFormatter maxHeaders(int value) {
219      if (value < 0)
220         throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxHeaders must be >= 0");
221      maxHeaders = value;
222      return this;
223   }
224
225   /**
226    * Overrides the cap on values scanned while computing omitted counts.
227    *
228    * @param value The new cap. Must be &ge; 0.
229    * @return This object.
230    */
231   public BasicRestDebugFormatter maxHeaderScan(int value) {
232      if (value < 0)
233         throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxHeaderScan must be >= 0");
234      maxHeaderScan = value;
235      return this;
236   }
237
238   /**
239    * Overrides the per header name/value length cap.
240    *
241    * @param value The new cap. Must be &ge; 0.
242    * @return This object.
243    */
244   public BasicRestDebugFormatter maxFieldLength(int value) {
245      if (value < 0)
246         throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxFieldLength must be >= 0");
247      maxFieldLength = value;
248      return this;
249   }
250
251   /**
252    * Overrides the rendered URI length cap.
253    *
254    * @param value The new cap. Must be &ge; 0.
255    * @return This object.
256    */
257   public BasicRestDebugFormatter maxUriLength(int value) {
258      if (value < 0)
259         throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxUriLength must be >= 0");
260      maxUriLength = value;
261      return this;
262   }
263
264   @Override /* Overridden from RestDebugFormatter */
265   public int bodyCap() {
266      return bodyCap;
267   }
268
269   @Override /* Overridden from RestDebugFormatter */
270   public String formatBasic(RestRequest req, RestResponse res) {
271      return statusLine(req.getHttpServletRequest(), res.getHttpServletResponse());
272   }
273
274   @Override /* Overridden from RestDebugFormatter */
275   public String statusLine(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res) {
276      var method = DebugTextSanitizer.sanitize(req.getMethod(), maxUriLength);
277      var uri = DebugTextSanitizer.sanitize(req.getRequestURI(), maxUriLength);
278      var sb = new StringBuilder();
279      // Prepend the resolved correlation id: read the session-cached getRequestId() through the
280      // session-handle seam — never a live public/custom-key attribute read.  Missing session/id → no prefix (today's
281      // unprefixed line), never a throw.  Both formatBasic and the 404 render path route through here.
282      var session = RestSession.fromRequest(req);
283      if (session != null) {
284         var id = session.getRequestId();
285         if (id != null && ! id.isEmpty())
286            sb.append("[requestId=").append(id).append("] ");
287      }
288      return sb.append('[').append(res.getStatus()).append("] HTTP ").append(method).append(' ').append(uri).toString();
289   }
290
291   @Override /* Overridden from RestDebugFormatter */
292   public String formatHeaders(RestRequest req, RestResponse res) {
293      var sreq = req.getHttpServletRequest();
294      var sres = res.getHttpServletResponse();
295      var sb = new StringBuilder();
296
297      var reqLen = req.getCachedContentLength();
298      if (reqLen >= 0)
299         sb.append("\n\tRequest length: ").append(reqLen).append(" bytes");
300
301      sb.append("\n\tResponse code: ").append(sres.getStatus());
302
303      var resLen = res.getCachedContentLength();
304      if (resLen >= 0)
305         sb.append("\n\tResponse length: ").append(resLen).append(" bytes");
306
307      var execTime = req.getExecTime();
308      if (execTime != null)
309         sb.append("\n\tExec time: ").append(execTime).append("ms");
310
311      var normalizedRedacted = normalizedRedactedSet();
312      appendRequestHeaders(sb, sreq, normalizedRedacted);
313      appendResponseHeaders(sb, sres, normalizedRedacted);
314
315      return sb.toString();
316   }
317
318   private void appendRequestHeaders(StringBuilder sb, HttpServletRequest sreq, Set<String> normalizedRedacted) {
319      var names = sreq.getHeaderNames();
320      if (names == null || ! names.hasMoreElements())
321         return;
322      sb.append("\n---Request Headers---");
323      var state = new HeaderScanState();
324      while (names.hasMoreElements() && ! state.scanCapped) {
325         var name = names.nextElement();
326         var redact = isRedacted(name, normalizedRedacted);
327         var sName = DebugTextSanitizer.sanitize(name, maxFieldLength);
328         var values = sreq.getHeaders(name);
329         appendHeaderValues(sb, sName, redact, values == null ? Collections.emptyIterator() : values.asIterator(), state);
330      }
331      appendOmissionMarker(sb, state.scanCapped, state.extra);
332   }
333
334   private void appendResponseHeaders(StringBuilder sb, HttpServletResponse sres, Set<String> normalizedRedacted) {
335      var names = sres.getHeaderNames();
336      if (names == null || names.isEmpty())
337         return;
338      sb.append("\n---Response Headers---");
339      var state = new HeaderScanState();
340      for (var name : names) {
341         if (state.scanCapped)
342            break;
343         var redact = isRedacted(name, normalizedRedacted);
344         var sName = DebugTextSanitizer.sanitize(name, maxFieldLength);
345         appendHeaderValues(sb, sName, redact, sres.getHeaders(name).iterator(), state);
346      }
347      appendOmissionMarker(sb, state.scanCapped, state.extra);
348   }
349
350   /**
351    * Emits (or counts as omitted) every value for one header name, shared by the request- and response-header render
352    * loops so neither has to nest a second scan/emit/omit loop inside its own.
353    */
354   private void appendHeaderValues(StringBuilder sb, String sanitizedName, boolean redact, Iterator<String> values, HeaderScanState state) {
355      while (values.hasNext()) {
356         if (state.scanned >= maxHeaderScan) {
357            state.scanCapped = true;
358            return;
359         }
360         state.scanned++;
361         var v = values.next();
362         if (state.emitted < maxHeaders) {
363            appendHeaderLine(sb, sanitizedName, redact ? RedactedHeaders.REDACTED : v);
364            state.emitted++;
365         } else {
366            state.extra++;
367         }
368      }
369   }
370
371   /** Mutable per-header-block emission/omission counters, threaded through {@link #appendHeaderValues}. */
372   private static final class HeaderScanState {
373      int emitted;
374      long extra;
375      int scanned;
376      boolean scanCapped;
377   }
378
379   private void appendHeaderLine(StringBuilder sb, String sanitizedName, String value) {
380      // Order: mask (already applied by caller) → escape → cap.
381      sb.append("\n\t").append(sanitizedName).append(": ").append(DebugTextSanitizer.sanitize(value, maxFieldLength));
382   }
383
384   private static void appendOmissionMarker(StringBuilder sb, boolean scanCapped, long extra) {
385      if (scanCapped)
386         sb.append("\n\t\u2026[more headers omitted]");
387      else if (extra > 0)
388         sb.append("\n\t\u2026[+").append(extra).append(" more headers omitted]");
389   }
390
391   @Override /* Overridden from RestDebugFormatter */
392   public String formatBody(RestRequest req, RestResponse res) {
393      var sreq = req.getHttpServletRequest();
394      var sres = res.getHttpServletResponse();
395      var sb = new StringBuilder();
396      appendBody(sb, "Request", req.getCachedContent(), req.getCachedContentLength(), sreq.getContentType(),
397         sreq.getHeader("Content-Encoding"));
398      appendBody(sb, "Response", res.getCachedContent(), res.getCachedContentLength(), sres.getContentType(),
399         sres.getHeader("Content-Encoding"));
400      return sb.toString();
401   }
402
403   private void appendBody(StringBuilder sb, String label, byte[] content, long totalLength, String contentType, String contentEncoding) {
404      if (content == null || content.length == 0)
405         return;
406      var byteCount = totalLength >= 0 ? totalLength : content.length;
407      var ctToken = contentTypeToken(contentType);
408
409      if (! isAllowDumpBodies()) {
410         appendPlaceholder(sb, label, byteCount, ctToken,
411            "; set " + ENV_ALLOW_DUMP_BODIES + " to enable", "body suppressed");
412         return;
413      }
414
415      if (! isRenderable(contentType, contentEncoding)) {
416         appendPlaceholder(sb, label, byteCount, ctToken, "; binary/non-renderable content", "body not rendered");
417         return;
418      }
419
420      var raw = new String(content, UTF8);
421      String bodyText;
422      if (bodyScrubber != null) {
423         String scrubbed;
424         try {
425            scrubbed = bodyScrubber.scrub(contentType, raw);
426         } catch (Throwable t) {  // NOSONAR - fail closed on any scrubber failure; never re-leak via the exception.
427            scrubbed = null;
428         }
429         if (scrubbed == null) {
430            appendPlaceholder(sb, label, byteCount, ctToken, "; scrubber failed", "body suppressed");
431            return;
432         }
433         bodyText = scrubbed;
434      } else {
435         bodyText = raw;
436      }
437
438      sb.append("\n---").append(label).append(" Content---");
439      sb.append('\n').append(DebugTextSanitizer.sanitize(bodyText, charCap()));
440      var omitted = byteCount - content.length;
441      if (omitted > 0)
442         sb.append("\n\u2026[truncated ").append(omitted).append(" bytes]");
443   }
444
445   private void appendPlaceholder(StringBuilder sb, String label, long byteCount, String ctToken, String reason, String verb) {
446      sb.append("\n---").append(label).append(" Content---");
447      sb.append("\n[").append(verb).append(": ").append(byteCount).append(" bytes, ").append(ctToken).append(reason).append(']');
448   }
449
450   private String contentTypeToken(String contentType) {
451      if (contentType == null || contentType.isBlank())
452         return "unknown";
453      return DebugTextSanitizer.sanitize(contentType, maxFieldLength);
454   }
455
456   private boolean isRenderable(String contentType, String contentEncoding) {
457      if (! isIdentityEncoding(contentEncoding))
458         return false;
459      return isBodyRenderable(contentType);
460   }
461
462   private static boolean isIdentityEncoding(String contentEncoding) {
463      if (contentEncoding == null)
464         return true;
465      var e = contentEncoding.trim();
466      return e.isEmpty() || eqic(e, "identity");
467   }
468
469   /**
470    * Returns the character-length cap for a dumped body, derived from {@link #bodyCap()}.
471    *
472    * <p>
473    * Worst-case escaping expands one byte to a 6-character {@code \\uXXXX} sequence, so the sanitized character cap is
474    * {@code bodyCap() * 6} (clamped to {@code Integer.MAX_VALUE}). Capture already bounds the raw bytes; this second
475    * layer bounds a scrubber that returns an oversized string.
476    */
477   private int charCap() {
478      var cap = Math.max(bodyCap, 0) * 6L;
479      return cap > Integer.MAX_VALUE ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : (int) cap;
480   }
481
482   private Set<String> normalizedRedactedSet() {
483      return redactedHeaders.stream().filter(Objects::nonNull).map(BasicRestDebugFormatter::normalizeHeaderName).collect(Collectors.toCollection(HashSet::new));
484   }
485
486   private static boolean isRedacted(String name, Set<String> normalizedRedacted) {
487      return name != null && normalizedRedacted.contains(normalizeHeaderName(name));
488   }
489
490   /** Case-folds and strips {@code -}/{@code _} and whitespace so {@code X-Auth-Token}/{@code X_Auth_Token}/{@code XAuthToken} all match. */
491   private static String normalizeHeaderName(String name) {
492      var sb = new StringBuilder(name.length());
493      for (var i = 0; i < name.length(); i++) {
494         var c = name.charAt(i);
495         if (c == '-' || c == '_' || Character.isWhitespace(c))
496            continue;
497         sb.append(Character.toLowerCase(c));
498      }
499      return sb.toString();
500   }
501
502   /**
503    * Returns whether body dumping is enabled by the {@code JUNEAU_REST_DEBUG_ALLOW_DUMP_BODIES} environment variable.
504    *
505    * <p>
506    * Resolved once from the environment and cached. Never reads a system property.
507    *
508    * @return <jk>true</jk> if body dumping is enabled.
509    */
510   static boolean isAllowDumpBodies() {
511      var v = allowDumpBodiesCache;
512      if (v == null) {
513         v = parseAllowDumpBodies(System.getenv(ENV_ALLOW_DUMP_BODIES));
514         allowDumpBodiesCache = v;
515      }
516      return v;
517   }
518
519   /**
520    * Parses a raw gate value with trim-then-parse truthy semantics.
521    *
522    * <p>
523    * The value is trimmed first; a non-empty trimmed value enables (returns <jk>true</jk>) except case-insensitive
524    * {@code false} or {@code 0}; {@code null}/empty/all-whitespace disables. This is a fail-safe kill switch, so
525    * ambiguous values resolve to disabled.
526    *
527    * @param raw The raw environment value. Can be <jk>null</jk>.
528    * @return <jk>true</jk> if the value enables body dumping.
529    */
530   static boolean parseAllowDumpBodies(String raw) {
531      if (raw == null)
532         return false;
533      var t = raw.trim();
534      if (t.isEmpty())
535         return false;
536      return ! (eqic(t, "false") || eq(t, "0"));
537   }
538
539   /**
540    * Test-only seam for exercising both gate states without mutating the process environment.
541    *
542    * <p>
543    * Package-private and unreachable from application code, and never reads a system property. Production resolution
544    * stays env-only / read-once ({@link #isAllowDumpBodies()}).
545    *
546    * @param override {@code null} clears the cache so the next resolution re-reads the environment once; a non-<jk>null</jk>
547    *    value is cached directly as the test gate state.
548    */
549   static void resetAllowDumpBodiesForTest(Boolean override) {
550      allowDumpBodiesCache = override;
551   }
552}
